description:
Delete the three lease APIs that no production code calls.

## Background

`ClaimCoordinator::acquire_claim` (`crates/jit/src/storage/claim_coordinator.rs:450`), `acquire_claim_with_reason` (`:527`) and `release_lease` (`:1087`) have no production caller, and no test calls them: tests acquire through `acquire_claim_synchronized` and release through the production release path. The test-only `acquire_claim` evicts and then returns without persisting the eviction (`:460-470`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ClaimCoordinator::acquire_claim`, `acquire_claim_with_reason` and `release_lease` no longer exist.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Test-only lease APIs are gone
